policy: Single fixed adaptive experiment, not an outer-fold hyperparameter search. Learn no-boundary/stop/restart with the native-prior-restoring event sampler. Features = existing 275 tracking-derived dead features plus cross-fitted dead probabilities and past/future changes over 0.2 to 5 seconds. Every outer training fixture receives upstream probabilities excluding both it and the outer fixture. Keep corrected combined ownership, dead emissions and ownership-switch evidence fixed. Only reduce stop/restart costs near learned boundaries. Original current deployment costs are the comparator; original nested benchmark remains a separately named diagnostic. Fit on DFL clean/moderate/severe inputs only. Contextual stress and absorbed labels are evaluation-only. No challenge or public-window inputs/labels, no Metrica training, no automatic promotion.
